sentences.zh: 其次，它的赛制基本上是把四个女孩和四个男孩安排在一栋别墅里。

sentences.zh: 在度过这八周的过程中，游戏的目标是保持恋爱关系。

sentences.en: And throughout the course of the series, the couples are given challenges to test their loyalty to their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 在整个系列节目中，情侣们会面临各种挑战，以考验他们对爱人的忠诚度。

sentences.en: And chaos ensues because most of the boys especially are quite unloyal.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一片混乱，因为大多数男孩（尤其是他们）都相当不忠。

sentences.en: And the aim of the game at the end is to win.

sentences.zh: 四个男孩，四个女孩。

sentences.zh: 你要做的是介绍这些原型中的每一个。

sentences.zh: 多米尼克和我则想出了一位我们认为符合该特定原型的历史人物。

sentences.en: So we will then describe them.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会对他们进行描述。

sentences.en: And you, at the end of our descriptions of these various characters, will decide which of them will pair off.
sentences.zh: 在听完我们对这些不同角色的描述后，你将决定他们该如何配对。

sentences.en: I cannot wait for this.
sentences.zh: 我已经迫不及待了。

sentences.zh: 所以每当有人被淘汰时，尤其是当他的岛上兄弟之一被淘汰时，他经常会哭泣。

sentences.zh: 他会非常难过。

sentences.en: Cracking.

sentences.zh: 但随后他在向伴侣表达同样程度的情感时会遇到一点困难，这让他的女伴十分苦恼。

sentences.en: So yes, that's our first one.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是我们的第一个原型。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I have chosen King Charles II, who is well known as the Merry Monarch.
sentences.zh: 我选择的是查理二世国王，他作为“快乐君主”而闻名。

sentences.en: And a huge part of his merriness is his fondness for japes, for horse racing, for wearing long wigs, for hanging out with orange sellers and actresses.
sentences.zh: 他快乐的很大一部分原因在于他喜欢恶作剧、赛马、戴长假发、与卖橘子的女贩和女演员厮混。

sentences.en: So he's a tremendous lad.
sentences.zh: 所以他是个了不起的家伙。

sentences.en: And this is very bad news for his wife, Catherine of Braganza, who comes from Portugal, princess, had been brought up in a convent, very, very pious.
sentences.zh: 这对他的妻子布拉干萨的凯瑟琳来说是个非常坏的消息，她来自葡萄牙，是一位公主，在修道院里长大，非常非常虔诚。

sentences.en: And so probably not a natural Love Island contestant.
sentences.zh: 所以她大概不是天生适合上《爱情岛》的选手。

sentences.en: So she's Catholic.
sentences.zh: 所以她是天主教徒。

sentences.en: Charles II is a Protestant, ruling a Protestant country.
sentences.zh: 查理二世是新教徒，统治着一个新教国家。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of hostility in Britain to Catherine of Braganza.
sentences.zh: 因此英国对布拉干萨的凯瑟琳存在很多敌意。

sentences.en: Charles does stand by her in that sense.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，查理确实支持她。

sentences.en: He doesn't kind of get rid of her, although there are all kinds of accusations are leveled against her, this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 他并没有把她抛弃，尽管各种各样的指控都指向她，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But basically, he is not going to stay at home and moon around the Queen, Catherine of
sentences.zh: 但基本上，他是不会呆在家里围着王后布拉干萨的凯瑟琳转的

sentences.en: Braganza, because he is out there having fun.
sentences.zh: 因为他在外面寻欢作乐。

sentences.en: So his backdrop, of course, is that his dad had his head chopped off.
sentences.zh: 当然，他的背景是他的父亲被砍了头。

sentences.en: So he's got quite a lot of issues to work through.
sentences.zh: 所以他有很多心理问题需要解决。

sentences.en: I mean, it's quite a lot of trauma there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那里有相当多的创伤。

sentences.zh: 他被流放了，因为英格兰被联邦和奥利弗·克伦威尔占领了。

sentences.en: Charles tried to come back, set himself up as a kind of, you know, a popular favorite, try and get people behind him.
sentences.zh: 查理试图卷土重来，把自己树立成某种，你知道的，深受大众喜爱的形象，试图争取人们的支持。

sentences.en: But they didn't really rally to him.

sentences.en: He got defeated in battle.
sentences.zh: 他在战斗中战败了。

sentences.en: So then he had to escape across England.
sentences.zh: 所以他不得不逃亡穿过英格兰。

sentences.en: He hid in an oak tree, very famously.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他躲在一棵橡树里。

sentences.en: But the great thing that enabled him to escape was his ability to blend in and to mingle and to play, you know, he's kind of a man of the people.
sentences.zh: 但他能够逃脱的关键在于他融入人群、交际和游玩的的能力，你知道的，他算是个平民主义者。

sentences.en: So even though he's a king, he has that kind of popular touch.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管他是国王，他身上却有一种亲民的作风。

sentences.en: And then when he comes back and he's king, it's been a very doer time under Cromwell.
